article_scope.purpose: conditional expression imputation at observed held-out slice locations and class labels
article_scope.artifact_policy: all frozen candidates remain noncanonical pending strict article-scope reruns and positive convergence evidence

engine.reference_selection: nearest lower/upper z references with declared nearest-z label donors from the full density pool

rng.requirement: future strict outputs must bind target, references, donors, weights, seed, diagnostics, input hashes, and output hash

solver.success_gate: positive tolerance-based convergence evidence for every saved transport record, finite counts, exact target identity, and exact 1122-gene order

fallback_policy.missing_label_support: only the declared nearest-z density-pool donor is allowed and must be recorded
fallback_policy.output_root: future strict reruns must use a new root

outputs.required_action: strictly rerun retained author-confirmed article-scope targets or remove the claim

evidence_binding.reason: 30 explicit failures, 26 failure-tainted outputs, and 37 outputs without positive convergence evidence

claim_limits: finite transport records must not be described as converged
the method is conditional imputation, not geometry-free reconstruction
exact target coordinates, class labels, z, and possible out-of-bracket donors must be disclosed
decision_required: confirm which density arms and targets are article scope before strict reruns
approve disclosure of observed target covariates and out-of-bracket label donors
